exposure: Misdiagnosis of antepartum fetal growth restriction (FGR)
cohort: 324,620 appropriate for gestational age (AGA) infants born between 1991-2020 at a tertiary medical center, including 3249 who were falsely classified as FGR antepartum.
finding: Misdiagnosis of fetal growth restriction (FGR) in the antepartum period is independently associated with an increased risk for offspring long-term neurological morbidities, specifically higher rates of hospitalizations due to various neurological conditions during childhood.
followup_time: Up to 29 years (spanning childhood, based on study period 1991-2020)
